literal_meaning: পায়ের কাছে পায়ের কাছে (প্রতি পদক্ষেপে অনুসরণ করে)
figurative_meaning_en: at every step; always accompanying closely
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্ধুটি তার সঙ্গী পায়ে পায়ে চলে।
example_sentences_in_english: The boy follows his mother at every step.
The friend tags along closely with his companion.
note: This idiom uses reduplication (দ্বিত্ব) to emphasize continuous following, common in Bengali expressive language.
